text: The breaking change this week is #13326, which makes five test-only IsHandled events in Fabric Platform Mgt internal, renames the Fabric mirroring app, drops the unused Key Vault client-ID lookup and moves telemetry to real audit logs; #12557 adds first-party app authentication to the same export. Posting and finance fixes changed behaviour: #13220 stops average cost overflow on same-period transfers, #13272 keeps historical FX balances when unapplying backdated payments, #13216 and #12474 correct VAT handling in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, and #12696 fixes Norwegian SAF-T 1.30 debit and credit totals. India GST received #13342, #13334 and #12979. Fixes for WIP transfer shipments (#13166, #13293) remove a wrongly required Bin Code, and Subscription Billing got #13240, #12998, #12519 and #12430. Time sheet copying now tolerates deleted work types (#13211), with read permissions added in #13435. Agent work includes Expense Agent corporate cards (#12147) and consumption V2 with a trial (#12539), plus Sales Order Agent changes in #13256, #12821 and #13307. Other fixes include #13159 for multi-document reminder PDFs and #13255 for the stuck vendor remittance export. Extensibility arrived through #10992, #13111 and #13261, and #13262 and #11222 improve performance.

issues: Minor omission: some behaviour-changing pull requests aren't mentioned, notably #12691 (German e-invoice registration number as buyer ID), #13105 (MCP empty configuration warning), #13052 (Shopify tax matching model upgrade) and #12996 (Sustainability reclassification CO2e). This doesn't make anything in the text wrong.
